## Validation
- [ ] Types, lint, format, tests, build and package inspection
- [ ] Regression test for reproduced bug, when practical
- [ ] Android/iOS device, OS, build, procedure and actual results (or Not Tested)

## Remaining risks and limitations

No tokens, personal logs, native binaries or fabricated measurements. Publication is separate owner approval.
